name: route_next
description: Decides which team member works the next turn, or signals that the work is done. ALWAYS use this instead of (or in addition to) the text markers 'AGENTE: @name' / 'FINE': it's the reliable way to route the team.

agent.description: Name of the member chosen for the next turn, as it appears in the team member list (with or without '@'), or 'FINE' if the task is resolved.

reason.description: Why this member (or ending the work) is the right choice at this point.
